forum.content_text:
Hello community,

I am working with different ibis model of STM32H7, however, this is the only one that's giving me an error in my Altium Designer – could you have a look at it?

The file is stm32h723\_730\_733\_lqfp144.ibs

Kind regards,

Javier.
forum.author: JavierGonzalez

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @JavierGonzalez and welcome to the community;

 

I don't think there's a problem with Ibis; rather, it's the Altium import tool. Usually, the models are tested with HyperLynx, please look at AN4803.

To solve the Altium issue, I recommend you to limit the length of reference names to 62 characters or fewer.

 

I hope this help you to solve the issue.

 

Thank you.

Kaouthar
